Set a prior lambda

opal_set_prior_lambda.Rd

Sets the contribution weight for all elements of a prior block or for one selected element. For an opal_obj, the updated object is returned through opal_update() so dependent results are invalidated.

Usage

opal_set_prior_lambda(x, parameter, value, element = NULL)

Arguments

x

An opal_obj or a named priors list.

parameter

Name of the parameter block.

value

Non-negative finite lambda value(s).

element

Optional one-based element index within the block, in column-major order for matrices. The block length must be known: from resolved parameters on an opal_obj, or from a vector par1, par2, or lambda.

Value

The updated opal_obj or priors list.
